en: Black-and-white panoramic view from an elevated hillside looking over a small town surrounded by fields and low hills. In the foreground are paths, fences and tall curved streetlamps on a sloping park-like area with a few people walking. Beyond, the town shows traditional European buildings with gabled roofs and church towers. The caption in German is printed at the bottom left.
